analysis.reason: 직전 판단(10월 30일)에서 RSI 39.2로 과매도 탈출 및 Higher Low 회복 초입을 확인하며 매수 진입. 현재가 $66.78은 스윙 지지선 $66.00에 근접하며, RSI 36.7로 여전히 과매도 구간에 머물러 있다. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이며 약세 수렴 중이다. analysis.reasonEn: Entered long on October 30th read, confirming RSI 39.2 exiting oversold and initial Higher Low recovery. Current price $66.78 nears swing support at $66.00, with RSI 36.7 still in oversold territory. MACD histogram shows improvement while in weak convergence. ADX at 16.5 indicates a non-trending phase, interpreting sharp declines as shock-like volatility. Volume ratio at 1.15 suggests momentum. With 1x target allocation filled, next move considers leverage.
